items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: I don't know how to sing with Isaiah Young, though.

ctx.x: I wonder, do you remember in unloading the boats, did they ever, or lifting coffee sacks or anything, did they ever have any little songs they'd sing or rhythms they'd go through, you know, to do it together to work?

No, I heard them fellas on the railroad do that. What did they do on the railroad? Huh? What'd they do on the railroad? Well, they'd be picking and singing. I don't know how to sing with Isaiah Young, though. Picking and singing. All kinds of stuff.
You never saw them do that and unload coffee?
